operationalization: APP Insurgence = emergence of an outbreak when cases more than replace themselves

wording: In a branching model of one introduced case, no outbreak reached 1,000 cases at R0 = 0.8; at R0 = 1.5 and 3 major outbreaks occurred in 58.1% and 94.1% of 20,000 runs (theory 58.3%, 94.0%), so even above the threshold many introductions die out. Changing the generation time from 3 to 15 days left the outbreak probability unchanged and stretched the time to 1,000 cases five-fold (44 vs 219 days at R0 = 1.5), illustrating P26's point that R0 is not a rate.
counterevidence_limits: Homogeneous Poisson offspring; fully susceptible population.
operationalization: APP Insurgence = outbreak emergence above R0 = 1
